title: Gospel Clarity & Christian Foundations
facts: Zionaviel provides comprehensive doctrinal walkthroughs anchored purely in Holy Scripture.
The Gospel section outlines God's plan of salvation, the person of Jesus Christ, and grace.
The Gospel Explore section features 9 foundational theological topics:
1. Who is Jesus? — The divine and human identity of the Son of God, His life, sacrifice, and divinity.
2. What is the Gospel? — The good news of redemption and reconciliation through Christ's death and resurrection.
3. Salvation — God's gracious rescue of humanity from sin, restoring our fellowship with God.
4. Grace — Unmerited divine favor; a free gift of God that cannot be earned by works.
5. Repentance — Turning away from self and sin toward God with a renewed mind and heart.
6. Faith — Active, unwavering trust in Jesus Christ and His finished work on the cross.
7. Resurrection — The bodily triumph of Christ over death and the grave, securing believers' eternal hope.
8. Eternal Life — The promise of unbroken fellowship, joy, and peace in God's presence forever.
9. How to Pray — Simple, heartfelt communication with your Heavenly Father.
